character.lede: Two near-equal modern volumes stand under opposed dark sheds, a walnut wing beside a blue-grey two-storey block. A charcoal forecourt with a reflecting basin leads to a timber pool deck.

spots.line: The Core sits on a desk in the hall, beside a tall plant.
A platform bed and a guitar stand share the bedroom.
Two bar stools sit at the deck bar by the pool.

facts.style: Two near-equal modern volumes under opposed dark sheds: a one-storey walnut west wing falling west over a fin-framed recessed porch, and a two-storey blue-grey east block falling east with its upper storey set back behind a planted white band; walnut pilasters, a charcoal forecourt and a reflecting basin in front, a timber pool deck wrapping the back

character.truths: The Core sits on a desk in the Desk Hall. The living room has a television. The kitchen has a breakfast bar. Forecourt with a reflecting basin, a timber pool deck, a roof terrace.

baikal: Whoever opens the app first runs the install wizard and sets the admin password
Overlaps Radicale and Nextcloud calendars: one calendar server per household
navidrome: Description says "from anywhere" and "works offline-first": paraphrase, remote access is not claimed
Already in 11 of 30 stories: one short of the cap of 12; rotate music beats to mStream, Swing Music and Music Assistant
vaultwarden: [note] Bitwarden-compatible server, unofficial. Do not say "Bitwarden".
photoprism: [note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
jellyfin: [note] Plays your own files. Say that, not "Netflix".
[claims] Do not say it plays copyrighted material from anywhere.
Plays your own media only: never "streams any movie".
QA capture is the setup wizard with a container id as the server name; the gallery frame is a demo library with lurid exploitation film posters: neither usable.
listmonk: [cloud-link] Sending at volume needs an SMTP provider or mail server. Do not promise delivery.
mealie: [note] Pasting a recipe URL fetches that web page. Everything it saves stays on your Core.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
pasting a URL fetches that web page
nextcloud: [note] The Hub onboarding wizard offers Nextcloud as a recommended app.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
homehub: No passwords: a "Select your user" box offers every name including Administrator (anyone on the network can pick one)
Extras bundled: recipes, expiry tracker, link shortener, PDF compressor, QR generator
ntfy: [cloud-link] iOS push goes through an upstream relay setting; Android and web can stay local.
No sign-in is configured: anyone who can reach the URL can publish and subscribe. Keep it on the home network.
iOS push goes through an upstream relay setting; Android and web can stay local.
QA screenshot is an empty app with a notifications-blocked banner (shows the product).
audiomass: The Core only serves the page: decoded audio and edits live in the viewer's browser, so "sits on the Core" is false until the person saves a file where they choose
Short description says "audio never leaves the appliance": an absolute; paraphrase
obsidian: [licence] Obsidian is not open source. Do not call it open source.
[note] An Obsidian MCP entry exists so an agent can read and write the vault.
not open source (catalog: never say so)
listing says private and offline: do not repeat
notes are files on the Core, the app is streamed
vikunja: QA shot is a sign-in wall
docuseal: [claims] Do not call signatures legally binding.
[note] Signers outside your home network need access to your Core.
Do not call signatures legally binding
syncthing: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
bentopdf: Dual licence: AGPL-3.0 or paid commercial; fine for household use
Listing says "nothing to leak": drop that wording
inkscape: Runs as a remote-desktop style session in the browser, not a native window
Image tag is the Kasm image version, not the Inkscape version
blinko: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
AI search and chat need a model provider added in the app (OpenAI, Ollama, LiteLLM...): not wired by the Hub.
No QA run; gallery frame is upstream marketing with a "#Password" tagged note and a gmail file name: reject.
Companion desktop and mobile clients are separate downloads.
espocrm: [note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
cryptgeon: Notes live only in RAM: a restart of the app wipes every unread note
Do not repeat the listing's encryption wording (sec-absolute); say a note opens once and is gone
Overlaps Enclosed and PrivateBin: one burn-after-reading tool per household
cryptpad: Listing says "end-to-end encrypted": banned wording (f-security-guarantee), do not repeat
Collaboration with people outside the home needs outside reach
pingvin-share: [public-access] Recipients outside your home network need to reach your Core.
public-access for anyone outside the house
adguardhome: [note] Overlaps Pi-hole; pick one per story.
[claims] Same as Pi-hole: no parental-control promise.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Listing mentions adult-content parental controls: never repeat it (sec-safety-people)
lubelogger: Do not claim savings or economy figures
No sign-in until the user sets one (unverified)
